# Comment and DM handling

**Who answers comments and delivers DMs?** · [all approaches](index.md) · clashes: C16


## Auto-DM on keyword
<a id="automation"></a>

A tool (ManyChat-style, parked as P4) sends the freebie when someone comments the keyword.

**Looks like:** The viewer comments 'CPU' and gets a DM with the link within seconds, even at 2 a.m. or at 2,000 comments.

**Good at:** scale; speed; consistent delivery

**Weak at:** impersonal; tool cost and setup; a robotic tone hurts trust

**Best for:** formats reel30, reel60, reel90 · niches all · goals comments, sales, speed · effort medium

**How:** Parked tool (P4); not set up. A manual copy-paste DM is the stand-in.

**Backed by:** [Comment KEYWORD and I'll send it](../topics/growth.md#growth-comment-keyword-cta), [Show the comment → DM funnel on screen](../topics/growth.md#growth-show-the-funnel), [Ideas from DM and comment questions](../topics/ideas.md#ideas-audience-questions-not-polls), [Reply to commenters yourself](../topics/growth.md#growth-reply-personally) · sources R1, research

## Reply yourself
<a id="personal"></a>

You reply to commenters personally, even if only a few a week. Teams reply only under a labelled account.

**Looks like:** Within the first hour every comment gets a real reply, inside jokes included. Commenters come back because you answered.

**Good at:** trust; community; ideas from questions

**Weak at:** doesn't scale; time every day

**Best for:** formats reel30, reel60, reel90, carousel, story · niches all · goals trust, comments, follows · effort medium

**How:** Block 15 minutes after posting. Note repeated questions as future topics.

**Backed by:** [Reply to commenters yourself](../topics/growth.md#growth-reply-personally), [First 60 minutes after posting](../topics/growth.md#growth-first-60-minutes), [Ideas from DM and comment questions](../topics/ideas.md#ideas-audience-questions-not-polls), [Comment KEYWORD and I'll send it](../topics/growth.md#growth-comment-keyword-cta) · sources L05, SP, KH

## Auto-deliver, personal replies
<a id="hybrid"></a>

The freebie arrives automatically; conversations and comment replies stay personal.

**Looks like:** The DM link lands instantly. You still reply to the first 20–30 comments yourself and answer follow-up DMs in your own words.

**Good at:** scale plus warmth; fast delivery; personal touch where it counts

**Weak at:** still needs daily time; two systems to run

**Best for:** formats reel60, reel90 · niches all · goals comments, trust · effort medium

**How:** Our inference; it depends on whether P4 is approved.

**Backed by:** [Reply to commenters yourself](../topics/growth.md#growth-reply-personally), [Comment KEYWORD and I'll send it](../topics/growth.md#growth-comment-keyword-cta), [First 60 minutes after posting](../topics/growth.md#growth-first-60-minutes), [Show the comment → DM funnel on screen](../topics/growth.md#growth-show-the-funnel) · sources L05, R1

## Mixing
Hybrid is the combination. At low volume, personal handling of the keyword DMs is the same as hybrid.

## Rule of thumb
Low volume: personal. Viral keyword reels: automation or hybrid.
